t: Beyond Life by James Branch Cabell | Goodreads
s: Beyond Life was republished in 1929 as the first book in a single 18-volume fantasy series, The Biography of the Life of Manuel—Cabell had reorganized almost all his earlier writing into this series, with minor editing to make it all fit together.
